div.head: Had 2
div.ab: And to hádbote, gif liflire wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, þone forman stæpe bete man mid punde ⁊ mid godcundre bote þingige georne.
⁊ to hádbóte, gif liflyre wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, þæne forman stæpe gebete man mid punde ⁊ mid godcundre bóte þingie georne.
⁊ to hadbóte, gif liflyre wurþe, toeacan þam rihtwere, þene forman stæpe bete man mid ane punde ⁊ mid godre bote þingie georne.
Et ad ordinis emendationem, si ordinatus occidatur, supra rectam weram, primus gradus una libra emendetur et dignam emendationem sedulo perquirat (digna penitentia s. perquiratur).

[45, 2] [2—8] Et si aliquis presbiterum occiderit, excepto eius iusto prętio, pro unoquoque ordine uiginti sol. emendet, uidelicet ad ordinem ostiarii uiginti sol., item ad exorcistam iterum uiginti sol., et sic per ordinem, usque transeat presbiteratum. [45, 3] Istę septem librę pro septem ordinibus erunt extra prętium quod dicitur þeregeld.
And to hadbote, gif liflyre wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, þene forman stæpe bete man mid ane punde and mid godre bote þingie georne.

Und wenn Verlust des Lebens [eines Klerikers] eintritt, büsse man [Verletzer] ausser dessen gesetzlichem Wergeld, als Klerusbusse den ersten Ordo durch 1 Pfund [Silber], und sühne willig durch geistliche (gute hq) Busse.

And if loss of life [of a cleric] occurs, let one [the offender] pay, besides his lawful wergild, as compensation for orders, for the first grade 1 pound [of silver], and make amends earnestly with spiritual (good, hq) penance.

And in compensation for [an offence against a man in] orders, if loss of life occur, one must pay for the first degree with a pound, in addition to the legal wergild, and intercede zealously with ecclesiastical penance….

And as compensation for one in orders if loss of life occurs, the perpetrator must make amends for the first rank by paying one pound in addition to the standard wergild, and he must diligently make peace by sincere atonement.
div.note: H's ‘godre’ is probably only a scribal error, but already in hq. H's ‘þene’ stands so.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘And in compensation for [an offence against a man in] orders, if loss of life occurs, one must pay for the first degree with a pound, in addition to the legal wergild, and intercede zealously with ecclesiastical penance.’).

Ostiar. For the lowest 5 orders, from it up to the subdeacon, Northu names no altar-compensation. A similar multiplication is found for the bishop, who is paid sevenfold, in the Canon Hibern.; cf. Seebohm Tribal Agsax. 104
